name: study-notes
description: Create and revise scholarly study notes, with an optional Markdown-to-HTML authoring specification.

interface.shortDescription: Write and review scholarly study notes.
interface.longDescription: Study-note authoring, explanatory-prose review, reader-state checks, and a documented HTML manuscript format. A renderer is not included.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use study-notes:study-note to create or revise this study note for its intended reader.
